## How to use this template

This `.qmd` is the canonical source. The HTML deck, the PDF backup, and the
`.pptx` copy are all rendered from it — never edit a rendered file. Build and
render commands are in `README.md`.

::: {.notes}
Speaker notes live in `.notes` divs. They carry through to both the HTML deck
and the PowerPoint copy.
:::

## A content slide

- Write ordinary Markdown
- Cite sources with `[@citekey]`, resolved from `references.bib`; for example,
  introductory epidemiology concepts can be grounded in [@rothman2012].
- Keep figures and data next to this file so the deck stays reproducible
